name: Chuugoku
source: China is one of the oldest nations and sees himself as a big brother to the other Asian nations. He ends all sentences with "-aru" and when he talks to England, he ends sentences with "-ahen" (opium). He enjoys cooking and cute things. The first time he meets Rare, he says she looks familiar and that she looks "Asian". He is in the Asian class together with Rare and Japan.
